care.summary: Elegant indoor tree with slender, arching leaves edged in red; one of the easiest houseplants.
care.light: Bright indirect light; tolerates low light but growth slows
care.water: Allow top 50% of soil to dry between waterings; reduce in winter
care.soil: Well-draining potting mix with perlite or sand
care.fertilizer: Balanced liquid fertilizer monthly in spring and summer
common_issues: Brown leaf tips from fluoride in tap water or low humidity
tips: Use distilled or filtered water to prevent brown tips
Prune leggy stems to encourage branching
Keep away from drafts and heating vents
